title: KIPFIN Backend
description:
Backend for the electronic gradebook of KIPFIN college, built on Spring Boot.

System features:
— Authentication via JWT + Spring Security
— Roles: Student, Teacher, Administrator
— Grade journal, final grades, attendance
— Class schedule, homework assignments
— Private messages between users
— Notifications via a Telegram bot
— File upload and delivery
— Versioned REST API (v1) for Web and Mobile clients
— Redis for caching
— Dotenv for configuration management
